verdict.rationale: Stripe ships extensive official SDK/CLI/protocol tooling for AI-native builders: a hosted MCP server (docs + runtime probe confirming live OAuth-gated endpoint), Link CLI published on npm with runtime verification, agent skills catalog served at a well-known JSON endpoint, restricted API keys guidance for agents, MPP/x402 machine-payment protocols with open spec and mppx conformance CLI, and one-prompt agent build flows. This is corroborated by independent runtime probes (npm resolution, live endpoint checks), not just vendor docs. missing for 10: no independent third-party developer testimonial/case study of building against these SDKs (only Stripe-run runtime probes and docs), and ACP/MCP write actions still require human approval gating rather than fully autonomous agent operation.
